blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Few-step distillation is essential for deploying modern video diffusion models. Among existing approaches, Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) has emerged as a highly promising paradigm by achieving strong output-space fidelity without adversarial training, while remaining flexible across various student architectures. We observe, however, that DMD fundamentally relies on an output-space objective, lacking explicit regularization on the model's internal representations. As the distillation step count aggressively shrinks, this output-only supervision becomes insufficient, causing the distilled student to degrade in both fine-grained spatial structures and coherent temporal dynamics. To address this limitation, we introduce Self Flow Forcing (SF$^2$), which incorporates a predictive representation loss into the DMD framework without altering its output objective. By providing the student and an Exponential Moving Average (EMA) teacher with heterogeneous noise levels, we establish an information asymmetry. This formulation forces the student to predict the teacher's internal representations from a more corrupted input, effectively integrating self-supervised representation alignment into distribution matching. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SF$^2$ effectively mitigates temporal flickering and consistently improves both spatial fidelity and motion quality. Furthermore, the proposed mechanism is architecture-agnostic - seamlessly supporting both bidirectional and causal models - and requires no external feature extractors, introducing minimal computational overhead.
blocks.zh: 少步分馏对于部署现代视频传播模型至关重要。 在现有的办法中,分配匹配消化(DMD)已成为一个很有希望的范例,在没有对抗性培训的情况下实现强大的产出-空间忠诚,同时在各学生结构中保持灵活性。 然而,我们注意到,多哈部长宣言从根本上依赖于产出-空间目标,对该模式的内部表述缺乏明确的正规化。 随着蒸馏步骤的急剧收缩,这种只输出的监管变得不足,使被蒸馏的学生在精细的空间结构和连贯的时间动态中退化. 为解决这一限制,我们引入了自流强制(SF ^2美元),在不改变产出目标的情况下,将预测性代表损失纳入DMD框架。 通过向学生和一位指示移动平均(EMA)教师提供不同噪音水平,我们建立了信息不对称。 这种提法迫使学生从更腐败的输入中预测出老师的内部代表,有效地将自我监督的代表配对整合到分配配对中. 广泛的实验表明,SF2美元有效缓解了时间闪烁,并持续地提高空间忠诚度和运动质量。 此外,拟议的机制具有结构不可知性,无缝地支持双向模型和因果模型,不需要外部特征提取器,采用最低限度的计算间接费用。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Video diffusion models [ 15 , 4 , 5 , 34 , 9 ] have recently delivered impressive advances in synthesizing high-fidelity, dynamic visual content. Yet, their iterative generation process typically requires tens to hundreds of denoising steps, posing a significant obstacle to real-world deployment.
To bridge this gap, various few-step distillation paradigms have been explored, including Consistency Models [ 35 , 28 ] , Trajectory Straightening [ 26 , 27 ] , and Adversarial Distillation [ 33 ] .
Among these, Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) [ 49 , 48 ] has emerged as a highly promising approach by achieving strong output-space fidelity,
while seamlessly supporting various student architectures.
blocks.zh:
视频传播模型[15,4,5,34,9]最近在合成高真实度,动态视觉内容方面取得了令人印象深刻的进展. 然而,它们的迭代生成过程通常需要数十至数百个降级步骤,对现实世界的部署构成重大障碍。
为了弥补这一差距,探索了各种几步蒸馏范式,包括一致性模型[35,28],轨迹直线化[26,27],和逆式蒸馏[33].
其中,分配匹配蒸馏(DMD)[49,48]通过实现强烈的输出-空间忠心,成为极有希望的方法,
同时也无缝支持各种学生建筑.

blocks.en:
However, when DMD is applied to the video domain, a characteristic degradation emerges at very low step counts.
Specifically, the few-step distilled student suffers along two critical axes of video quality: fine-grained spatial structures (e.g., text rendering, complex geometry, and small object details) become blurred or inconsistent, and motion exhibits pronounced temporal flickering and physically unnatural dynamics.
We observe this dual degradation in both our bidirectional and causal baselines, suggesting that it stems from the underlying distillation formulation itself rather than specific architectural choices.
blocks.zh:
然而,当DMD被应用于视频领域时,在极低的台阶计数中会出现特征降解.
具体来说,几步蒸馏的学生沿着视频质量的两个关键轴线受苦:精细的空间结构(如文本渲染,复杂的几何学,以及小物体细节)变得模糊或不一致,运动展品表现出时间闪烁和物理上不自然的动态.
我们从双向基线和因果基线中看到这种双重退化,这表明它源于基本的蒸馏配方本身,而不是具体的建筑选择。

blocks.en:
We attribute this degradation to DMD’s exclusive reliance on output-space supervision.
DMD trains the student by matching its marginal samples to the teacher’s at the output level, but it lacks explicit regularization to enforce the alignment of internal representations.
In standard multi-step diffusion, this output-level proxy is sufficient, as the student can gradually refine its predictions and absorb fine-grained structures through iterative denoising.
As the step budget aggressively shrinks, however, this proxy becomes inadequate.
The student lacks the iterative capacity to recover rich, structured internal features, leading to the observed deterioration in both spatial fidelity and temporal coherence.
blocks.zh:
我们把这种退化归因于DMD完全依赖输出空间监督。
DMD通过将边际样本与教师的输出水平匹配来训练学生,但缺乏明确的正规化,无法强制实施内部代表的对齐.
在标准的多步骤传播中,这种输出级代用已经足够,因为学生可以通过迭代去诺来逐渐完善预测,吸收精细的纹理结构.
然而,随着该步骤预算的大幅度缩减,这一代名词变得不足。
学生缺乏迭代能力来恢复丰富的结构化内部特征,导致观察到的空间忠贞性和时间一致性的恶化.

blocks.en:
A complementary perspective from self-supervised representation learning offers a natural solution to this structural degradation.
Classic predictive frameworks, from masked autoencoding [ 12 , 39 ] to V-JEPA [ 1 ] , have established that representation-level prediction enforces robust spatiotemporal understanding.
Recent methods [ 51 , 6 , 19 ] have successfully adapted this principle for generative models, proving that internal feature regularization directly translates to higher generation fidelity.
DMD, by contrast, is entirely devoid of such explicit representation-level guidance, optimizing only the marginal output distribution.
blocks.zh:
从自我监督的代表性学习中找到一个互补的观点,为这种结构性退化提供了自然的解决办法。
经典的预测框架,从蒙面的自动编码[12,39]到V-JEPA[1],已经确定,代表级的预测可以促进有力的瞬间理解.
近代方法[51,6,19]成功地对这个原则进行了基因模型的调整,证明了内部特征正规化直接转化为更高代的忠诚.
相比之下,债务管理和发展司完全没有这种明确的代表性指导,仅优化了边际产出分配。

blocks.en:
Motivated by this observation, we introduce SF 2 , a novel paradigm that injects a predictive representation objective directly into the DMD framework without altering its output loss.
The core mechanism is to establish an information asymmetry between the student and an Exponential Moving Average (EMA) teacher.
By feeding the two networks with heterogeneous noise levels, we present the student with a more corrupted view of the underlying sequence and force it to predict the teacher’s robust internal representations.
This formulation explicitly integrates self-supervised representation alignment into distribution matching.
Importantly, our mechanism requires no external feature extractors—the teacher is a self-bootstrapped EMA of the student—and adds only one extra forward pass per iteration, remaining agnostic to the specific architectural form of the generator.
blocks.zh:
基于这一观察,我们引入了SF 2,这是一种新颖的范式,它直接向DMD框架注入一个预测性代表目标,而不改变其输出损失.
核心机制是确定学生与一名指示移动平均教师之间的信息不对称。
通过向两个网络提供不同程度的噪音,我们向学生展示了一个更腐败的视角,并迫使学生预测教师强有力的内部表现。
这种表述方式明确将自我监督的表示式配对整合到分配配对中.
重要的是,我们的机制不需要外部特征提取器——老师是学生的自我启动的EMA——每次重复只增加一个前传通行证,对发电机的具体建筑形式仍然不可知。

blocks.en:
We validate SF 2 across two representative video distillation settings: a bidirectional text-to-video student and a causal autoregressive student, building upon the standard ODE-initialization protocols [ 53 ] .
In both scenarios, SF 2 effectively mitigates temporal flickering and consistently improves both spatial fidelity and motion quality with minimal computational overhead.
blocks.zh:
我们通过两个有代表性的视频蒸馏设置验证SF 2:一个双向文本到视频的学生和一个因果自动递减的学生,基于标准ODE-初始化协议[53].
在这两种情况下,SF 2有效缓解了时间闪烁,并始终提高空间忠诚度和运动质量,同时尽量减少计算费用。

blocks.en: In summary, our main contributions are:
blocks.zh: 总之,我们的主要贡献是:

blocks.en: • We identify a critical limitation of applying standard DMD to video generation: its exclusive reliance on output-space supervision lacks explicit regularization for the student’s internal representations. In the few-step regime, this results in the widely observed spatial artifacts and temporal flickering. • We propose SF 2 , which incorporates a predictive representation objective into the DMD framework. By utilizing heterogeneous noise levels and an EMA teacher to create an information asymmetry, we force the student to predict the teacher’s internal representations from a more corrupted view, effectively integrating representation-level alignment with distribution matching. • Extensive experiments on bidirectional and causal video distillation settings demonstrate that SF 2 consistently enhances spatial fidelity and temporal coherence, all while requiring no external feature extractors and introducing minimal computational overhead.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Self Flow Forcing sits at the intersection of two rapidly evolving domains: the acceleration of video diffusion models through step distillation, and the enhancement of generative paradigms via self-supervised representation learning. We briefly review both areas and position our contribution.
blocks.zh: 自流强制坐落在两个快速演变的领域的交汇处:通过步骤蒸馏加速视频传播模型,通过自我监督的表达学习增强基因模式. 我们简要地回顾了这两个领域,并确定了我们的贡献。

blocks.en: 2.1 Efficient Video Distillation
blocks.zh: 2.1 高效率的视频稀释

blocks.en:
Step distillation aims to compress the iterative sampling process of diffusion models into a few steps.
In the image domain, paradigms such as Progressive Distillation [ 32 ] , Consistency Models [ 35 , 28 ] , Adversarial Diffusion Distillation [ 33 ] , flow-based trajectory straightening [ 26 , 27 ] , and Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) [ 49 , 48 ] have established the feasibility of few-step generation.
These acceleration frameworks have subsequently been extended to the video domain.
This includes bidirectional text-to-video adaptations such as VideoLCM [ 44 ] , T2V-Turbo [ 24 ] , and PCM [ 42 ] .
In parallel, causal autoregressive generation frameworks have been accelerated through CausVid [ 50 ] , Self-Forcing [ 16 ] , and Causal-Forcing [ 53 ] .
However, a persistent commonality across these methods is their exclusive reliance on marginal output distribution supervision, leaving the student’s internal representations completely unconstrained.
We identify this output-only supervision as the fundamental structural cause of the spatial degradation and temporal flickering widely observed in few-step distilled video models.
Self Flow Forcing addresses this limitation by introducing a representation-level objective that operates orthogonally to the existing output objective.
blocks.zh:
步骤蒸馏旨在将扩散模型的迭代取样过程压缩为几个步骤.
在图像领域,诸如渐进式蒸馏[32],一致性模型[35,28],逆向蒸馏[33],流线轨迹整齐[26,27],分布式匹配蒸馏[49,48]等范式确立了几步生成的可行性.
这些加速框架后来扩大到视频领域。
这包括双向文本到视频改编,如VideoLCM [44],T2V-Turbo [24],以及PCM [42].
同时,通过CausVid [50],Self-Forcing [16]和Causal-Forcing [53]加速了因果自动生成框架.
然而,这些方法之间持续存在的共同点是,它们完全依赖边际产出分配监督,使学生的内部代表完全不受限制。
我们认为,这种仅限产出的监督是空间退化和时间闪烁的基本结构原因,在几步蒸馏的视频模型中广泛观察到。
自我流动强制措施通过引入代表级目标来解决这一限制,该目标正统地适用于现有的产出目标。

blocks.en: 2.2 Self-Supervised Representation Learning in Generative Models
blocks.zh: 2.2 基因模型中的自我监督代表性学习

blocks.en:
A growing body of work demonstrates that integrating representation-level priors into generative training yields cleaner internal features and superior generation quality.
This integration typically follows two distinct routes.
The first route injects semantic priors directly into the latent space: methods such as VA-VAE [ 47 ] , SemanticGen [ 2 ] and RAE [ 52 ] align or replace the standard VAE latents with rich semantic features from frozen external perception encoders [ 29 , 40 , 3 ] .
The second route operates within the generative backbone itself: REPA [ 51 , 23 ] aligns the intermediate layers of a diffusion transformer with these frozen external encoders during training.
To remove the dependency on external extractors, SRA [ 19 ] provides representation guidance via self-distillation, while Self-Flow [ 6 ] integrates a predictive objective by feeding heterogeneous noise levels across tokens, creating an information asymmetry the network must inherently resolve.
blocks.zh:
越来越多的工作表明,将代表级别前科纳入基因培训可产生更清洁的内部特征和更高的生成质量。
这种整合一般遵循两种不同的路线。
第一条路线直接向潜在空间注入语义学前缀:方法如VA-VAE [47],语义学Gen [2]和RAE [52] 调和或替换来自冷冻的外部感知编码器具有丰富语义学特征的标准语义学前缀[29,40,3].
第二条路线在基因主干内部运行: REPA [51, 23] 在训练期间将扩散变压器的中间层与这些冷冻的外部编码器对齐.
为了消除对外部提取器的依赖,SRA [19]通过自我消化提供表达指导,而Self-Flow [6]通过将不同噪声水平的摄入到各种符号中来整合一个预测目标,从而形成一个信息不对称的网络必须内在解决.

blocks.en:
This predictive, asymmetric paradigm is particularly crucial for the video domain.
As established by architectures like V-JEPA [ 1 ] and VideoMAE [ 39 ] , learning to predict the representations of masked (perturbed) observations serves as a powerful inductive bias for capturing complex spatiotemporal dynamics.
However, while the aforementioned representation strategies successfully enhance the training of base multi-step generative models
—which operate with large step budgets and extensive data
—their potential within the highly compressed regime of few-step model distillation remains entirely unexplored.
Self Flow Forcing bridges this gap. By porting the predictive representation-forcing principle into video distillation via asymmetric noise, we force the student to capture robust spatiotemporal dynamics, effectively repairing the degradation of DMD without relying on external encoders.
blocks.zh:
这种预测性,不对称的范式对于视频领域特别关键.
正如V-JEPA[1]和VideoMAE[39]等建筑所建立的那样,学习预测蒙面(扰动)观测的表示,成为捕捉复杂瞬间动态的强大诱导偏差.
然而,虽然上述代表战略成功地加强了基础多步骤基因模型的培训
——以大步预算和大量数据运作.
——它们在极压缩的几步模型蒸馏制中的潜力仍然完全没有得到探索.
自流强化了这一差距。 通过将预测性表现力强制原理移植到通过不对称噪声的视频蒸馏中,我们迫使学生捕捉强力的瞬间动态,在不依赖外部编码器的情况下有效修复DMD的降解.

blocks.en: 3 Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 3 序言

blocks.en:
Modern video generators are dominated by diffusion and flow-matching models [ 31 , 25 ] , which produce high-quality samples at the cost of tens to hundreds of sequential evaluation steps.
Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) addresses this inference bottleneck by compressing such multi-step generators into few-step students via score matching in the output space.
While this serves as the universal foundation for our distillation framework, evaluating few-step causal autoregressive models introduces an additional train–test mismatch, which is effectively resolved by Self-Forcing [ 16 ] . SF 2 builds upon these foundational concepts, which we briefly review below.

现代的视频生成器以传播和流配模型[31,25]为主,以数十到数百个相继评价步骤为代价,产生高质量的样本.
分配匹配抖动(DMD)通过在输出空间的分数匹配将这种多步生成器压缩为几步学生来解决这个推论瓶颈.
虽然这是我们蒸馏框架的普遍基础,但评估几步因果自动递减模型引入了额外的列车-测试不匹配,通过自强制[16]有效解决. 《战略框架2》以这些基本概念为基础,下文简要回顾这些概念。

While standard DMD is sufficient for bidirectional video distillation, causal autoregressive video generators face an additional context-conditioning challenge.
Standard teacher forcing conditions every generated chunk on clean ground-truth history, causing severe error accumulation during autoregressive inference.
Diffusion forcing [ 7 ] relaxes this by assigning independent noise levels per chunk, yet the conditioning history still relies on real data rather than the model’s own predictions.
Self-Forcing [ 16 ] closes this train–test gap by rolling the student out chunk-by-chunk on its own previously generated context. By propagating information via a key-value (KV) cache, training and inference share the exact same conditioning distribution.
We adopt this protocol as the foundation for our causal autoregressive experiments.

In this section, we present SF 2 , a framework for few-step video distillation.
As identified in Sec. 3 , a fundamental limitation of DMD is its exclusive reliance on output-level supervision, leaving the internal representations entirely unconstrained.
Under aggressive few-step compression, this unconstrained freedom becomes harmful: the student tends to converge to shortcut representations that merely minimize the marginal distribution loss, fundamentally lacking temporal and structural coherence.
SF 2 closes this gap by aligning the student’s intermediate features with those of an exponential-moving-average (EMA) teacher using deliberately asymmetric inputs, while preserving the original DMD output objective.
Concretely, we maintain three modules during training: the student G θ G_{\theta} , an EMA teacher G θ ′ G_{\theta^{\prime}} with identical architecture but no gradients, and the standard DMD critics s ψ s_{\psi} and s real s_{\text{real}} .

Thus, the additional computational cost is dominated by a single teacher forward pass and remains independent of the number of denoising steps.

blocks.en: 4.1 Asymmetric Inputs from a Shared Trajectory
blocks.zh: 4.1 共享轨道的不对称输入

blocks.en:
In standard generative training, uniform noise is typically applied across all spatial-temporal tokens.
The resulting denoising objective can often be minimized by exploiting low-level, local correlations, providing little incentive for the model to capture deep semantic structures.
To break this local dependency, we draw inspiration from Self-Flow [ 6 ] and introduce information asymmetry.
The core idea is to apply heterogeneous noise levels across different tokens, forcing the student to proactively infer heavily corrupted regions using the global context provided by cleaner tokens.
blocks.zh:
在标准的基因培养中,统一的噪声一般适用于所有时空符号.
由此产生的去名目标往往可以通过利用低层次的,局部的相互关系而最小化,为模型捕捉深层次的语义结构提供很少的动力.
为了打破这种本地的依赖,我们从自流[6]中汲取灵感,引入信息不对称.
其核心思想是在不同标志上应用不同噪声级别,迫使学生利用清洁标志提供的全球背景,主动推断严重腐败的地区.

blocks.en:
However, introducing this asymmetry naively—such as completely masking out a subset of tokens or assigning independent, randomized noise levels to every token—severely disrupts the underlying generative dynamics and creates a significant train–inference mismatch.
To safely establish this asymmetry without compromising the generative pipeline, we adopt a dual-timestep formulation.
Starting from a shared denoising trajectory, the student receives a token-level mixture of a noisier state and a cleaner state, whereas the teacher observes exclusively the cleaner state. Consequently, the student must predict the teacher’s representations from a strictly more corrupted vantage point, circumventing trivial self-reconstruction while seamlessly integrating representation learning into distribution matching.

为了安全地确定这种不对称,同时又不损害基因源流,我们采用了双时步配方。
从一个共同的去名轨迹开始,该学生得到一种象征性的、由噪声状态和清洁状态组成的混合体,而教师则完全遵守清洁状态。 因此,学生必须从更腐败的有利角度来预测教师的表述,避免微不足道的自我重建,同时无缝地将表述学习与分配匹配结合起来。

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: To evaluate the effectiveness of SF 2 , we structure our experiments to answer three core questions: (1) How do the asymmetric masking strategies influence representation learning across different generation paradigms? (Sec. 5.2 ); (2) Does the representation alignment translate into perceptually coherent motions and detailed spatial structures? (Sec. 5.3 ); and (3) Does SF 2 quantitatively outperform recent state-of-the-art multi-step and distilled video generators? (Sec. 5.4 ).
blocks.zh: 为了评价SF 2的有效性,我们安排了我们的实验,以回答三个核心问题: (1) 不对称的掩盖战略如何影响不同代范式的代表性学习? (第5.2条); (2) 代表性的调整是否转化为概念上一致的运动和详细的空间结构? (第5.3节)和(3) SF 2在数量上是否超过了最近最先进的多步骤和蒸馏视频生成器? (第5.4节).

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
We instantiate SF 2 across both bidirectional and causal paradigms to demonstrate its versatility.
For the bidirectional setting, we employ two structurally distinct backbones: Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B [ 41 ] as our primary model, and HunyuanVideo-1.5 [ 45 ] to evaluate generalizability.
Notably, HunyuanVideo-1.5 utilizes an MMDiT [ 11 ] architecture with strong text-rendering capabilities, serving as a stringent visual probe for spatial fidelity preservation during few-step distillation.
For the causal autoregressive setting, we initialize the student from Causal-Forcing [ 53 ] ODE-regression checkpoint, enabling us to evaluate the chunk-by-chunk representation forcing under a genuine key-value (KV) cache rollout.
blocks.zh:
我们通过双向和因果模式,即时分析SF 2,以显示其多功能性。
对于双向设置,我们使用两个结构上不同的骨干: Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B[41]作为我们的主要模型,HunyuanVideo-1.5[45]用来评价通用性.
值得注意的是,HunyuanVideo-1.5利用了具有强大文本传送能力的MMDit[11]架构,在几步蒸馏过程中充当空间忠诚性保存的严格视觉探测器。
对于因果的自动递减设置,我们从Causal-Forcing[53] ODE-递减检查站初始化学生,使我们能够评价在真正的键值缓存(KV)推出下强迫的逐个组合表示.

blocks.en:
All configurations follow the established recipe [ 48 , 16 ] , wherein the two score critics are drawn from the student’s model family.
Specifically, for the Wan2.1-based students (both bidirectional and causal), we use the frozen Wan2.1-14B [ 41 ] as the real-score model and initialize the learnable fake-score model from Wan2.1-1.3B.
For the HunyuanVideo-1.5 bidirectional student, the real-score model is the frozen HunyuanVideo-1.5 [ 45 ] and the fake-score model is initialized from the same HunyuanVideo-1.5 checkpoint.
We use K = 4 K{=}4 denoising steps for both bidirectional and causal students.
To ensure structural consistency across different backbones, the SF 2 branch extracts features based on fixed depth ratios rather than absolute layer indices: the student and teacher features are read at depths ℓ θ = 0.3 ​ N b \ell_{\theta}{=}0.3N_{b} and ℓ θ ′ = 0.7 ​ N b \ell_{\theta^{\prime}}{=}0.7N_{b} , respectively, where N b N_{b} is the total number of transformer blocks.

Our primary evaluation protocol is VBench [ 17 ] : we run the official prompt suite and report the Total Score, Quality Score, and Semantic scores.
To complement these distributional metrics with a per-sample measure of human visual preference, we additionally report the VisionReward [ 46 ] score — a learned reward model trained to predict human preferences over generated videos, which is computed on a curated 100 100 -prompt set with rich motion and complex actions provided by [ 53 ] .
We further report Throughput (samples/s) and Latency (s/sample) on a single H100 GPU.
For ablations we use VBench Quality as the headline single-number proxy.

blocks.en:
The two patterns reach comparable Quality (with space-only attaining a higher ceiling at convergence), but split on the two temporal-coherence metrics:
space-only yields a higher Dynamic Degree, while agnostic produces a higher Background Consistency.
We attribute this trade-off to a temporal-copy shortcut: under agnostic sampling, each masked token is likely left clean at the same spatial location in an adjacent frame, so the student can minimize the rep loss by copying along the time axis — biasing it toward over-similar adjacent frames, which inflates background consistency and suppresses motion.
Space-only sampling closes the shortcut: with the same mask broadcast across all frames, every spatial location is either clean or masked throughout the entire window, forcing reconstruction from spatial neighbors instead of from another time step. We adopt space-only as the default.
blocks.zh:
两种模式达到可比较的质量(仅空间在趋同时达到更高的上限),但在两种时间一致性度量上却有分歧:
仅空产生更高的动态度,而不可知性则产生更高的背景一致性。
我们把这个取舍归结于时间复制的捷径:在不可知的采样下,每个蒙面符号很可能在相邻框架的同一个空间位置被保持干净,因此学生可以通过沿着时间轴复制来尽量减少代表损失——将其偏重于过于相似的相邻框架,这夸大了背景一致性,抑制了运动.
仅限空间采样关闭了快捷键:在覆盖所有帧的相同遮罩下,每个空间位置要么是干净的,要么是整个窗口的遮罩,迫使来自空间邻居的重建而不是另一个时间步. 我们把仅空作为默认。

blocks.en: 5.3 Qualitative Results
blocks.zh: 5.3 定性结果

blocks.en:
Fig. 2 compares autoregressive rollouts on identical prompts and seeds for the multi-step Wan2.1 teacher and four few-step distilled causal students: CausVid [ 50 ] , Self-Forcing [ 16 ] , Causal-Forcing [ 53 ] , and SF 2 .
The improvement of SF 2 over the baselines is the global, physically-grounded structure that the rep loss compresses into the student’s hidden states, which surfaces as four distinct facets of representation-level coherence across the figure.
(Top-left) Articulated-motion plausibility: the soccer player’s pose stays anatomically valid frame to frame, while baselines produce snapping or rerouted limbs. (Top-right) Event irreversibility: the destroyed wall stays destroyed, whereas baselines reconstitute or even regrow it across consecutive frames. (Bottom-left) Object persistence: the red ribbon remains a single continuous object throughout the dance, instead of vanishing, splitting, or warping. (Bottom-right) Scene-structural stability: horse and rider counts, identities, and overall layout stay coherent. Each baseline failure is a different symptom of the same missing internal abstraction, and SF 2 addresses all four through a single representation-level objective.

SF 2 相对于基线的改进是全球的、以物理为基础的结构,该代表丧失后压缩成学生的隐形状态,而这种结构是整个图中代表级别一致性的四个不同方面。
(左转) 假说- 运动 合理性: 足球运动员的姿势在解剖学上保持有效框框, 而基线则产生断断或调整的四肢。 (右转) 事件不可逆性:被摧毁的墙仍然被摧毁,而基线则重建或甚至跨越连续的框架重新建造。 (左转) 物体恒定:红丝带在整个舞蹈中始终是一个单一的连续物体,而不是消失,分裂,或扭曲. (Bottom-right)场景结构稳定性:马和骑手计数,身份,整体布局保持连贯. 每个基线故障都是同一缺失内部抽象的一个不同症状,SF 2通过单一代表级目标解决所有四个问题.

blocks.en:
Fig. 5 compares two few-step HunyuanVideo-1.5 students — the plain DMD baseline and SF 2 — on prompts containing in-scene text.
We use HunyuanVideo-1.5 here precisely because its multi-step teacher already renders non-trivial text; any degradation under distillation therefore directly probes how much fine spatial structure the student retains.
The DMD student loses this ability: glyphs become blurred, distorted, or scrambled into wrong characters, indicating that output-only supervision is too coarse to preserve the highly structured spatial features that text requires.
Adding the rep loss restores it: SF 2 produces sharp, legible text across all four prompts.
Since text rendering is a stringent visual probe of spatial representation quality, this is direct evidence that SF 2 strengthens the student’s internal spatial features.
blocks.zh:
图5比较了两个几步骤的HunyuanVideo-1.5学生——平面DMD基线和SF 2——对含有内色文本的提示.
我们在这里使用HunyuanVideo-1.5正是因为其多步骤的老师已经制造出非三角文字;在蒸馏下的任何降解都直接探究了学生保留了多少细微的空间结构.
DMD学生失去了这种能力:glyphs变得模糊,扭曲,或者拼写成错误的字符,表明只输出的监管过于粗糙,无法保存文本所需要的高度结构化的空间特征.
添加代表损失可以恢复: SF 2 在所有四个提示中产生尖锐,清晰的文本.
由于文本渲染是对空间表现质量的严格视觉探测,这直接证明SF 2加强了学生的内部空间特征.

We curate 120 120 prompts depicting static scenes under smooth camera trajectories, reconstruct each generated video into a 3D Gaussian Splatting [ 22 ] representation via WorldMirror-2 [ 18 ] , re-render along the original trajectory, and report PSNR / SSIM / LPIPS against the generated frames, alongside VBench’s Temporal Flickering and Subject Consistency as direct measures of frame-level coherence.
On top of HunyuanVideo-1.5, SF 2 improves over vanilla DMD on every reconstruction and coherence metric at matched Dynamic Degree (Table 3 ).
Since no 3D supervision is used at any stage of training, this gain is attributable solely to the feature-level alignment of Sec. 4 , providing direct evidence that the rep loss shapes the student’s internal representation rather than only its output distribution.

blocks.zh: 表3:通过重新移交和框架一级的一致性来检验代表性的质量。 我们报告PSNR / SSIM / LPIPS 对照生成的帧,加上V Bench Temperal Flickering 和背景一致性. 尽管培训期间没有使用3D监督,但SF 2改进了与香草DMD相匹配的每个动态度的重建和一致性衡量标准。

blocks.en:
To rigorously quantify the robustness of the learned internal representations, we test how faithfully a generated video can be reconstructed as a unified 3D scene.
Specifically, if the model has learned a strong internal representation, its generated videos will maintain strict temporal consistency, which naturally leads to highly accurate 3D reconstructions with minimal rendering error.
We curate 120 120 prompts featuring static scenes navigated by smooth camera trajectories.
Each generated video is lifted into a 3D Gaussian Splatting [ 22 ] space via WorldMirror-2 [ 18 ] and re-rendered along its original camera path.
We report the reconstruction fidelity (PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS) against the original generated frames, alongside VBench’s Temporal Flickering and Subject Consistency metrics to directly assess frame-level continuity.
As reported in Table 3 , SF 2 (applied to the HunyuanVideo-1.5 backbone) strictly surpasses the vanilla DMD baseline across every reconstruction and coherence metric, while maintaining an equivalent Dynamic Degree.
Crucially, since no 3D supervision is injected at any stage of training, these geometric and temporal improvements are solely attributable to the feature-level alignment formulated in Sec. 4 .
This serves as compelling quantitative evidence that the SF 2 mechanism fundamentally enhances the student’s intrinsic spatial-temporal awareness, moving beyond mere output-level distribution matching.
blocks.zh:
为了严格量化所学到的内部表现的强性,我们测试一个生成的视频如何能忠实地重建为一个统一的3D场景.
具体来说,如果模型已经学会了强大的内部表现,其生成的视频将保持严格的时间一致性,这自然会导致高度精确的3D重建,并最小的渲染错误.

关键的是,由于在培训的任何阶段都没有注入三维监督,这些几何和时间上的改进完全归因于第4节中阐述的特征级别一致。
这成为令人信服的量化证据,证明SF 2机制从根本上增强了学生固有的时空意识,超越了单纯的输出级分布匹配.

blocks.en:
To further demonstrate the versatility of SF 2 , we extend our evaluation to an interactive video generation [ 10 ] setting using WorldPlay [ 37 ] .
WorldPlay is a causal autoregressive model that synthesizes interactive environments, conditioned on camera and action inputs.
The original WorldPlay relies on an output-space distillation method akin to Self-Forcing [ 16 ] .
We upgrade this distillation pipeline with SF 2 and evaluate the model’s ability to follow complex control signals.
For evaluation, we condition the models on a sequence of input camera trajectories, compute the actual synthesized camera poses from the generated long videos using WorldMirror-2 [ 18 ] , and measure their alignment with the ground-truth input conditions.
As illustrated in Fig. 6 , SF 2 achieves significantly higher translation accuracy, rotation accuracy, and overall action accuracy across training steps compared to the WorldPlay baseline.
Furthermore, Fig. 7 visualizes the the camera trajectories. The trajectory generated by SF 2 visibly conforms much closer to the input ground-truth camera path, whereas the baseline trajectory drifts.
This affirms a core insight: interactive autoregressive generation is fundamentally a state-transition learning problem.
By enforcing a more compact and structurally coherent internal representation, SF 2 equips the model to learn more precise state transitions, directly resulting in generated environments that strictly obey external conditional controls.
blocks.zh:
为了进一步证明SF 2的多功能性,我们利用WorldPlay [37] 将评价推广到交互式视频生成[10] 设定。
WorldPlay是一种因果自递性模型,它合成了交互环境,以相机和动作输入为条件.
最初的WorldPlay依赖于类似于自强制的输出-空间蒸馏法[16].
我们用SF 2来升级这个蒸馏管道,并评估该模型跟踪复杂控制信号的能力.
为了评价,我们以一系列输入相机轨迹作为模型的条件,用WorldMirror-2[18]来计算生成的长视频中实际合成的相机姿势,并测量它们与地面真实输入条件的一致.
如图6所示,与WorldPlay基线相比,SF 2在培训步骤中实现的翻译精度、旋转精度和整体动作精度显著提高。
此外,图7还可视化了相机的轨迹. SF 2产生的轨迹明显接近输入地面-真实相机路径,而基线轨迹则漂移。
这证实了一种核心的见解:互动的自动递减生成从根本上来说是一个国家过渡学习问题。
通过执行更紧凑和结构上一致的内部代表,SF 2使模型能够学习更精确的状态过渡,直接导致生成的环境严格遵守外部条件控制.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We presented SF 2 , which closes a structural blind spot of DMD by adding a predictive representation objective on top of its output loss.
Through asymmetric inputs and a self-bootstrapped EMA teacher, the student is forced to align its internal features with the teacher’s under information loss, supplying the representation-level signal DMD lacks.
The mechanism is paradigm-agnostic and adds negligible cost, and consistently improves both spatial fidelity and temporal coherence across bidirectional and causal video generators on architecturally distinct backbones. We view SF 2 as evidence that, in the few-step regime, what the student learns to represent matters as much as what it learns to output.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了SF 2,它通过在输出损失之外加上一个预测性表示目标,关闭了DMD的结构盲点.
通过非对称输入和自我启动的EMA教师,学生被迫将自己的内部特征与老师在信息损失下的功能相配合,从而提供DMD缺乏的表示级信号.
该机制具有范式不可知性,增加了可忽略不计的成本,并不断改善在建筑上独特的主干线上双向和因果视频生成器的空间忠诚性和时间一致性。 我们认为SF 2是证明,在少数步骤的政权中,学生学会代表什么与其学会输出一样重要.

We then ask VisionReward to score both videos and record the per-prompt preference (the higher-scoring video wins). Each bar in Fig. 4 reports the fraction of prompts on which SF 2 is preferred over the corresponding baseline; the prompt set, seed, and generation hyperparameters are fixed across all four pairings.

blocks.en:
For the representation-quality probe of Table 3 , we curate 120 120 prompts depicting predominantly static scenes under smooth camera trajectories.
For each prompt, the trained student generates a video, which is then reconstructed into a 3D Gaussian Splatting representation via WorldMirror-2 [ 18 ] ; the resulting 3DGS scene is re-rendered along the original camera trajectory. PSNR / SSIM / LPIPS are computed between the re-rendered and the original generated frames, and Temporal Flickering / Background Consistency are computed via VBench on the original generated frames. No 3D supervision is used at any stage of training, so any improvement in PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS is attributable to the representation-level objective rather than to direct 3D regularization. We additionally pin the Dynamic Degree of the two compared methods (the DMD baseline and SF 2 ) so that any reduction in the residual cannot be “bought” by suppressing motion.

对于每个提示,训练有素的学生会生成一个视频,然后通过WorldMirror-2[18]重建成3D Gaussian Splating代表;由此而来的3DGS场景会沿着原相机轨迹重现. PSNR / SSIM / LPIPS 是在重置的和原生成的帧之间计算出来的,而Temperal Flickering / 背景一致性是通过在原生成的帧上通过V Bench计算出来的. 在培训的任何阶段都不使用3D监督,因此PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS的任何改进都归因于代表级目标,而不是直接实现3D规范化. 此外,我们还将两种比较方法(DMD基线和SF 2)的动态度定值,以便通过抑制运动来“争取”减少残余物。

blocks.en: Appendix F Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录F 限制

blocks.en: SF 2 is a distillation-time objective: it does not add new capabilities to the student beyond what its multi-step teacher can express. Concretely, prompt adherence on long compositional prompts and on rare visual concepts is upper-bounded by the teacher’s behavior, and any biases of the underlying training corpus (cultural skew, demographic representation, domain coverage) are inherited unchanged. The rep loss can sharpen the student’s internal features but cannot manufacture concepts the teacher does not represent.
blocks.zh: SF 2是一个蒸馏时间目标:它不会为学生增加超出其多步老师所能表达的新能力. 具体地说,教师的行为决定了迅速遵守长的构成提示和稀有视觉概念,对基本培训机构的任何偏见(文化特征、人口代表性、域覆盖)没有改变。 失去代表可以强化学生的内部特征,但不能制造教师不代表的概念。

blocks.en: We instantiate SF 2 on two structurally distinct backbones (Wan2.1 and HunyuanVideo-1.5) and on both bidirectional and causal paradigms, but other architectural families — e.g. purely-attention-free state-space backbones or hybrid architectures — are out of scope of this paper and may require revisiting the layer-pair selection rule.
blocks.zh: 我们在两个结构不同的骨干上(Wan2.1和HunyuanVideo-1.5)以及在双向和因果范式上对SF 2进行即时分析,但其他建筑家族——例如纯粹无留心的状态空间骨干或混合结构——不在本文的范围之内,可能需要重新审视层间选择规则。
